annotations.title: Sectors and their stocks, ranked by returns in this market regime

description: Which sectors and stocks have done best and worst in markets like today's? Returns the ten sectors of the regimecard.com stocks page ranked by their stocks' median typical return over 1, 2 or 3 months from the current regime, each with its five highest and five lowest. With one sector named, every stock in it, ranked. It covers the stocks with Regime Card pages. Any other US stock can be checked one at a time with /v1/lookup. $0.05 per call in USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana (x402). One sector: $0.03 per call. Settled figures, updated after each US close: the ones the stock pages on regimecard.com print. Useful when an agent needs sector rotation context for the current market regime.

inputSchema.description: Query parameters, all optional. Any other value is a free 400.

sector.description: One sector: all its covered stocks, ranked, at the one-sector price. Without it, every sector.

name: sector_leaders

asOf.description: The trading session this response describes (YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern).

dataAsOf.description: The newest day of stock prices in the figures (YYYY-MM-DD).

disclaimer.const: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.

horizon.description: The holding period the figures and the ranking use.

record.description: The public, hash-linked record of the daily settled regime reading: its percentile and its regime label. It covers nothing else in this response: not the stress gate, stock or coin figures, the scorecard, or a live intraday reading. The same on every response.

covers.description: The reading it covers: the percentile and the regime label of each daily settled reading, and nothing else in this response.

ledger.description: Every entry as JSON, each with the hash of the entry before it.

note.const: Each settled regime reading is added to a public, hash-linked record the day it is published; a correction is a new entry, never an edit.
note.description: The same facts in one plain sentence.

verify.description: The page that explains the hash chain and checks every entry in the browser.

key.description: The regime, as a stable key.

label.description: The regime, as the card prints it.

related.description: The other paid routes: for each, its path, the question it answers and its price per call. Each is a separate call.

path.description: The route's path on this origin.

per.description: What the price is for: one call, or each covered symbol of one call.

priceUsd.description: The price in US dollars, paid in USDC.

research.description: A published Regime Card study of the current regime. Present only when one exists for it.

sectors.description: Without a sector named: every sector, ranked by its figure, highest first (a sector with no figure is listed last), each with highest and lowest. With a sector named: that sector alone, with its place among the sectors, and stocks.

highest.description: Every sector: its 5 highest ranked stocks, in rank order.

history.description: How much history is behind the figures: full, limited, or none (too little to print a figure; the stock is not ranked).

rank.description: Its place in its sector, by the typical return at this horizon, highest first. Rows that print the same figure share a place. Null with too little history: then it is listed last.

roseSharePct.description: How often the stock rose over the horizon when it started in the current regime, in percent of past periods.

typicalReturnPct.description: The stock's typical (median) return over the horizon when it started in the current regime, in percent. The figure on its page.

url.description: The stock's page on regimecard.com, with the same figures.

history.description: How much history is behind the sector figure: limited when more than half of the stocks behind it have limited history, none when there is no figure.

id.description: The sector, as a stable id: one of the values the sector query parameter takes.

lowest.description: Every sector: its 5 lowest ranked stocks, in rank order, the lowest last. A stock listed under highest is not repeated here, so a sector with few ranked stocks lists fewer.

history.description: How much history is behind the figures: full, limited, or none (too little to print a figure; the stock is not ranked).

rank.description: Its place in its sector, by the typical return at this horizon, highest first. Rows that print the same figure share a place. Null with too little history: then it is listed last.

roseSharePct.description: How often the stock rose over the horizon when it started in the current regime, in percent of past periods.

typicalReturnPct.description: The stock's typical (median) return over the horizon when it started in the current regime, in percent. The figure on its page.

url.description: The stock's page on regimecard.com, with the same figures.

name.description: The sector, as the regimecard.com stocks page names it.

rank.description: Its place among the sectors, by the typical return at this horizon, highest first. Rows that print the same figure share a place. Null with too little history: then it is listed last.

stocks.description: One sector: every covered stock in it, ranked, then the stocks with too little history, in symbol order.

history.description: How much history is behind the figures: full, limited, or none (too little to print a figure; the stock is not ranked).

rank.description: Its place in its sector, by the typical return at this horizon, highest first. Rows that print the same figure share a place. Null with too little history: then it is listed last.

roseSharePct.description: How often the stock rose over the horizon when it started in the current regime, in percent of past periods.

typicalReturnPct.description: The stock's typical (median) return over the horizon when it started in the current regime, in percent. The figure on its page.

url.description: The stock's page on regimecard.com, with the same figures.

stocksCovered.description: How many stocks with a page on regimecard.com the sector has.

stocksRanked.description: How many of them have enough history at this horizon to be ranked.

typicalReturnPct.description: The median of the typical returns of the sector's covered stocks that have enough history at this horizon, in percent, one decimal. The regimecard.com stocks page prints no sector average, so this figure is computed for this route from those stocks' own published figures. Null with fewer than 3 such stocks.

status.description: "live": computed during the session and still provisional. "settled": final for its session.
